data.summary_suggestion: Initiate frame-and-speech analysis of a YouTube video

Each new analysis consumes 1 Cloud Request plus mode-specific AI Units; duplicate requests (same video, mode, range) return the existing job without additional charges. Poll the returned jobId to retrieve results when status is 'ready'.
